name: Vert
description: The next-generation file converter. Open source, fully local and free forever.
composeYaml:
services:
  vert:
    image: 'ghcr.io/vert-sh/vert:latest'
    environment:
      - 'PUB_VERT_URL=${APP_URL}'
      - 'PUB_HOSTNAME=${APP_URL}'
      - PUB_PORT=80
      - PUB_ENV=production
